messages:
anna: Quick heads up — APAC account blocked from provisioning p4d due to missing business identity docs. Getting ENI errors when creating node groups.
priya: On it. Which exact doc are they asking for? link to AWS console? :eyes:
finance-bot: Automated notice: Account 12345 requires Organization Registration Document and VAT/Tax Certificate to lift commercial restrictions.
mike: We saw ENI quota errors too: "InsufficientFreeAddressesInSubnet" during cluster scale. That looked like subnet ENI-per-instance limit being hit.
thomas: Could we fallback to p3dn for now? Need to check model perf, but better than waiting.
anna: p3dn is fine as temporary. But our load tests need p4d throughput. Also partner rep says they'll only process once identity docs uploaded.
priya: I can upload docs but we need correct legal entity name. Who owns the contract? @mike?
mike: Legal entity is Redwood Inference, Inc. VAT number provided in last contract email. I'll forward the signed W-9 and company registration scan.
anna: Please cc finance@redwood.com when you send. Also open a support case with AWS for ENI quota increase: requested 500 -> 1200 per region. I left a draft in jira: INFRA-987.
thomas: For short term, can we adjust CNI config to use fewer secondary IPs (ipam settings) to reduce ENI usage? That saved us last time.
mike: Yes, lowering maxPods per node helps. Pushing a patch: 
```
spec:
  kubelet:
    maxPods: 64
```
should cut ENI count ~30%.
priya: Filing the AWS business docs upload now, and opening the quota case. Will ask rep for expedited review. ETA 24-48h.
anna: Cost note: if we switch regions for p4d (us-west-2 -> ap-southeast-1) partner surcharge may apply. Keep finance in loop.
finance-bot: Reminder: Any cross-region footprint may trigger separate billing account verification — contact billing@redwood.com.
mike: Action items: 1) I send W-9 + reg cert (mike -> finance) 2) Priya uploads docs & opens quota ticket 3) Thomas applies CNI tweak 4) Anna coordinates fallback to p3dn. I'll post updates here.
priya: Uploaded docs at https://aws.amazon.com/my-account/documents/attachment/abcd, case #1234567890. Notified rep.
anna: Thanks — marking as in-progress. If AWS approves quota before EOD we start provisioning. :thumbsup: 
sre-bot: Deploy pipeline check: no active rollouts blocked by this change.
mike: sent mail to finance@redwood.com with attachments, cc anna. Waiting for confirmation from billing.
finance-bot: Payment method verified. Awaiting legal confirmation on entity name formatting.
priya: AWS case updated: rep says they need notarized copy for APAC region due to local regs. Rep offered expedited path if we provide notarized docs by tomorrow.
anna: Ugh. Priya, can you confirm if we have notarized copy? If not let's get notarization service via DocuSign partner. I'll loop legal.
mike: Legal says we can get notarization same day via vendor. I'll start that now.
thomas: Keeping cluster replicas lower until p4d available to avoid costs. Setting autoscaler max to 20%.
anna: Great. We'll reconvene here after notarization upload. Thanks everyone.
